'''Wicket33 Hunt Down And Destroy anything that moves (plus The Jedi)''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Wicket33]]
* '''Published:''' 7 July 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif|label=Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS2 HD Wicket33 DS 2002 HuntDown.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Hunt Down deck that has done pretty well but could use some more tweaking. Thanks for any help.

The published list has 67 cards.

== Strategy ==

This deck is a straight-foward Hunt Down. Tilted force activate ratio between me and opponent (8:2; plus force for Sith, Holotheatre, Hallway). High destiny (20 draws 4 or above). No space because the only space decks around here are EBO, WYS, and Hidden Base; and all three slaughter DS space defense.
